notes.title: Patched! (Feb 19, 2023)
notes.content:
Thanks for playing Elohim Eternal: The Babel Code!

I've squashed missed bugs based on the comments received from the community on Steam. 

The bug fixes included:
- changes to a few areas where you could get unlimited talents
- visual bugs fixed
- teleport bugs fixed

tags.bug: - changes to a few areas where you could get unlimited talents
